reviewer: Codex model reviewer /root/citation_design_review; independently reviewed by root Codex model; no human or paid judge
rubric: protocol.md; scalar values 0 / 0.5 / 1. Correctness and completeness are frozen requested-point coverage, including failed cases as zero; contextual details not requested are not required. Citation and faithfulness units are factual claim groups (paragraph/bullet), not token counts. Missing-information claims are scored separately. Compound claim groups receive partial support when a material qualifier is unsupported. Citation support pools the cited passages for one claim; citation coverage requires a supporting inline citation on that claim group. Claim-free answers have no citation/faithfulness denominator; they still affect correctness, abstention and reliability.
rubric_source: ../20260927-financial-acceptance/protocol.md and ../20260927-financial-acceptance/reviewed-cases.json, including its explicit fiscal-period inference allowance; no historical rescoring
review_scope: All six new final answers, every factual paragraph/bullet and all 16 requested fact instances. Original page 1 was visually reviewed; all supplied source bodies, table locations and supplements were inspected. Stream deltas, final answer, saved answer, sources and retrieval history were compared. Scores and scoped gates remain conditional on the existing fiscal-period inference allowance; they do not assert that every qualifier is explicitly stated in the cited passage. See the separate citation-qualifier-audit.json.

grouping_decisions: Claim units remain factual paragraphs or bullets. A citation on one bullet does not cover another. All 16 current groups have their own inline citation.

Both apparent-conflict no-contradiction introductions are scored as factual groups. Neither current answer repeats the conclusion in a later closing paragraph, so there is no repeated introductory framing to exclude. The previous run's explicitly excluded repeated framing remains unchanged.

Quarter/full-year and fiscal-Q4 wording retains the explicit historical allowance as a reasonable inference from the same-ending three- and twelve-month financial periods. This is a scoring allowance, not a finding that source 1 explicitly establishes those fiscal-calendar labels; citation-qualifier-audit.json records the strict source distinction.
94.93 billion and rounded 391.04 billion are correct arithmetic conversions of 94,930 and 391,035 million. Extra conversions do not add requested gold points.

Units repeated within the income bullets fully answer the units request; a separate units sentence is unnecessary. The share-count/per-share exceptions are preserved in evidence and do not apply to the requested sales or income amounts.

clarifications: The previous planned-income first bullet remains uncited in its historical record. The new planned-income answer has an inline [1] on both separate bullets.
